_meta.method: First-party check of Philippine Zen group pages and current temple event/contact pages on 2026-10-08.
_meta.coverageEstimate: Medium-high for the Sanbo Zen lineage centers (Manila, Baguio, Iloilo, Cotabato, Davao). Adequate coverage of the Chung Tai institutional branch.
knownGaps: Holy Mountain Zen Center referenced in brief not verified to a current independent URL; the Mountain Sangha / Baguio Zen Center may be its successor.
Plum Village Philippines lay sanghas not enumerated with separate URLs.
No Sotoshu-listed Soto Zen temple in the Philippines found in official directory.

places.name: Zen Center Manila (Heroes Hill Zendo)
places.address: Heroes Hill, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines
places.notes: The centre identifies its Sanbō Zen International practice. Its visible site text describes weekly online practice and a suspension of in-person retreats and visitor facilities, but linked schedule material dates to 2020–21. Current online and in-person activity, venue access, and schedule remain unconfirmed.

places.name: Baguio Zen Center (Mountain Sangha)
places.notes: The center identifies the Baguio Mountain Sangha and posts a Saturday sitting schedule at St. Scholastica’s Convent, 108 Wagner Road. The schedule page has no recent date; confirm the next sitting and venue before attending.

places.name: Zen Philippines (Zen Center of Oriental Spirituality)
places.notes: The center identifies its Sanbo Zen lineage and a Marikina zendo at 34 St. Claire Street, Provident Village. Its page contains conflicting Sunday cadence descriptions; check the current event or orientation page for the next in-person session.

places.name: Iloilo Zen Center
places.notes: Zen Center Manila’s affiliate page lists an Iloilo group, but the listing supplies no dated current schedule or venue confirmation. Current local practice is unverified; the city pin is approximate.

places.name: Davao Zen Center
places.notes: Zen Center Manila’s affiliate page lists a Davao group, but the listing supplies no dated current schedule or venue confirmation. Current local practice is unverified; the city pin is approximate.

places.name: Ocean Sky Chan Monastery (Chung Tai Philippines)
places.address: 716 Jose Abad Santos St., Little Baguio, San Juan, Metro Manila, Philippines
places.notes: The monastery’s own site identifies its Chung Tai Chan affiliation and publishes 2026 retreat notices. Its site lists 716 Jose Abad Santos Street, Little Baguio, San Juan; confirm event dates with the monastery.

places.name: Foguangshan IBPS Manila (Mabuhay Temple)
places.address: 656 Pablo Ocampo Sr. Avenue, Malate, Manila
places.notes: Fo Guang Shan’s Manila temple publishes visiting information and address details. It is a broad Humanistic Buddhist institution; no recurring Zen or Chan meditation schedule is asserted.
